node: Hyperscaler, AI cloud and sovereign AI compute demand
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the AI compute-demand node beyond the seed hyperscalers. The strongest additions are companies that either own AI cloud capacity, sell deployable AI server systems, or own scarce powered data-center capacity. Priority candidates for later evidence work: Oracle as a hyperscale AI cloud platform with large AI/cloud backlog; CoreWeave and IREN as AI cloud/neocloud capacity owners; Dell as a scaled AI-optimized server supplier to neocloud, sovereign, enterprise and cloud customers; and Digital Realty as a large data-center asset owner with hyperscale AI-oriented leasing evidence. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
